children: Meta Platforms, the social, advertising and AI-platform company

, stays at to $741.39 at 10.55am ET on October 6, 2026, as investors weighed its push into enterprise AI. The company launched Meta Enterprise Platform on September 28, bringing Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code into a new business aimed at corporate customers. The ambition is clear: turn its AI spending into another revenue engine.

Meta named former MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to run the platform, reporting directly to Mark Zuckerberg. That puts an experienced enterprise operator in charge of selling AI tools to businesses. Meta already reaches hundreds of millions of businesses through its existing platforms. Those relationships could open doors, but converting an advertiser into a paying software customer still requires products that deliver measurable results.

The valuation picture shows shares 13.98% below the $861.84 GF Value estimate, suggesting potential upside if Meta delivers. Enterprise customers will expect dependable security, support and pricing alongside capable AI. The launch announcement provided no contract totals or revenue timetable. Distribution gives Meta a strong starting position. Paying customers and repeatable revenue will determine whether this becomes a meaningful business.

title: Meta Stocks Stay Flat as Muse Opens an Enterprise Front
